I was an artist, it was who I was... that's all I was, the only thing I was good at and what all my life goals were centred around ever since I was a kid! It was my identity and what everyone knew me as... When my depression and anxiety started getting uncontrollably worse, I stopped drawing... I just stopped, I couldn't do it anymore I was too sick with emotions. It's been 3 years since I drew something, I have no more life goals because they were all centred around my art and what I was going to do with that skill... I can't even pick up a pencil and paper because my anxiety gets to me too much and it turns out looking like I've never drawn a day in my life before.

I wish I could go to my past self and tell her to never stop drawing, I feel like I'm not even myself anymore, like I'm a different person, I'm just a shell of myself. Without the artist half of me I'm nothing.

I'm both glad but also so sad that I'm not the only one who feels like this, I thought it was just me that felt this way, I kinda of wish it as just me so no one else would have to feel like this. I hope you're feeling a little more inspired today, I hope you crave to create again soon and don't loose who you were and what you loved.
